title.target: Prepositions: time, place and dependent prepositions
title.en: Prepositions: time, place and dependent prepositions

ex.t: The result depends on the weather.
I'm looking forward to the weekend.
Don't worry about it too much.

title.ko: in · on · at · by · for · since + 의존 전치사(depend on · look forward to)
title.en: in, on, at, by, for, since, and dependent prepositions

explain.ko: 시간 전치사: at은 정확한 시각(at nine), on은 요일과 날짜(on Monday), in은 월·연도·계절·하루 중 시간(in May, in the morning). by는 '~까지 (끝내야 한다)', for는 기간(for five years), since는 시작점(since 2020)입니다. 장소는 in(큰 공간 안), on(표면 위), at(지점)으로 구분합니다. 의존 전치사는 형용사·동사마다 고정된 짝을 이루므로 함께 외웁니다: depend on, look forward to + -ing, good at, worry about, responsible for, different from.
explain.en: Time prepositions: at for exact times (at nine), on for days and dates (on Monday), in for months, years, seasons and parts of the day (in May, in the morning). By means no later than, for shows a period (for five years) and since gives the starting point (since 2020). For place use in (inside), on (surface) and at (point). Dependent prepositions come in fixed pairs with verbs and adjectives, so learn them together: depend on, look forward to + -ing, good at, worry about, responsible for, different from.

notes.ko: look forward to 뒤에는 to부정사가 아니라 -ing 또는 명사가 옵니다.
notes.en: After look forward to use -ing or a noun, not a base verb.
By is a deadline; until means continuing up to a time.

notes.ko: 전치사는 영어와 한국어가 일대일로 대응하지 않으니 덩어리로 외우세요.
notes.en: Prepositions don't map one-to-one between English and Korean; learn them in chunks.

examples.t: The result depends on the weather.
I'm looking forward to the weekend.
I took part in the marathon.

lines.t: When shall we meet? How about Monday morning?
Good. Let's meet in the office at nine.
We have to hand in the report by Friday, don't we?
Yes. The result depends on the customer's reaction.

trans.ko:
A: 언제 만날까? 월요일 아침 어때?
B: 좋아. 9시에 사무실에서 만나자.
A: 보고서는 금요일까지 제출해야 하지?
B: 응. 결과는 고객의 반응에 달려 있어.

lines.t: I've worked at this company for five years. I'm responsible for training new staff in the marketing team. On Mondays there is usually a meeting, and weekly reports are handed in by Friday. I'm looking forward to a business trip abroad next month.

trans.ko: 저는 이 회사에서 5년째 일하고 있습니다. 저는 마케팅팀의 신입 사원 교육을 책임지고 있습니다. 월요일에는 보통 회의가 있고 금요일까지 주간 보고서를 제출합니다. 다음 달에는 해외 출장을 기대하고 있습니다.

prompt.ko: 약속이나 계획에 대해 시간·장소·의존 전치사를 사용해 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about an appointment or plan using time, place and dependent prepositions.

task.model: We'll meet in the office on Monday morning at nine. I have to hand in the report by Friday. The result depends on the customer's reaction. I'm looking forward to starting the project.

model_trans.ko: 우리는 월요일 아침 9시에 사무실에서 만날 거예요. 저는 금요일까지 보고서를 제출해야 해요. 결과는 고객의 반응에 달려 있어요. 저는 그 프로젝트를 시작하기를 고대하고 있어요.
model_trans.en: We'll meet in the office on Monday morning at nine. I have to hand in the report by Friday. The result depends on the customer's reaction. I'm looking forward to starting the project.
